cases.case_label: Alu insertion at codon 876 (exon 7) of CASR
cases.disease: Familial hypocalciuric hypercalcemia / neonatal severe hyperparathyroidism
cases.mechanism_detail: Alu inserted at codon 876 in exon 7 introduces stop codons in all three reading frames, producing receptors truncated by ~30 kD with no calcium response and reduced cell-surface expression; polymerase stalling at the Alu poly(T) tract was also seen in vitro.
cases.quote: The insertion resulted in truncated receptor species that had molecular masses some 30 kD less than that of the wild-type CASR and exhibited no Ca2+(i) responses
